Hey Google, generate a poem about impotent incels raging over AI translating japanese porn comics.

An angry incel turned into something strange,
Angered at easy translations done with modern change.
A black screen reflects a glowing glare,
As impotent anger fills up the air.

With rage comments and fury they sink,
Only to pause and stare and carefully re-think.
Why must the machine write translations so clear,
And tell a distant truth that now feels so near?
